messages:
rebecca_cs: Kestrel dedicated bring-up kickoff. Need final quota numbers, autoscale policy, and a short load-test window. Customer aiming for prod traffic by next Wed EOD. @omar_sre can you confirm sizing? :calendar:

omar_sre: Confirming current committed = 8x A100. Recommend reserving +2 GPUs for burst -> 10 committed, allow autoscale up to 14 for safety. Proposed autoscale policy: min=2, target_util=65%, max=14. Any objections?

li_devex: No objections. I'll draft the enablement playbook (ops handoff + runbook) and attach a trimmed checklist. Also will add a short training session for Kestrel app team.

sanjay_pm: Heads up — renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks. If latency/cost regressions show up during ramp we should flag CSM + AE. Please capture baselines so we can show improvements.

katie_cust: From customer side: traffic mix = 60% chat (short context), 30% embeddings, 10% batch reranks each morning. Peak concurrency expected ~450 reqs/min during batch windows. They also want an opt-out fallback to smaller model for non-critical queries.

omar_sre: Ok noted. For fallback we'll route to kestrel-6B-quant on high queue depth. Policy: if queue_length > 200 or p95 latency > 600ms, fallback.

rebecca_cs: Proposed load-test slot: Tuesday 14:00-15:30 UTC. Minimal blast: 15m baseline ramp, 60m sustained, 15m cooldown. Can ops + devex own orchestration?

li_devex: I'll own orchestration + enablement during test. Plan to collect token-level latencies and token cost breakdown. Please send prompt sets.

rebecca_cs: Sending prompt sets now (short + long + embeddings). Also capture a couple of golden outputs to evaluate quality drift.

deploybot: load-test job queued by @rebecca_cs — id=lt-kestrel-176999. Will report start/finish.

omar_sre: Quick load-test command we'll run in staging: 

```
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 60m -e MODEL=kestrel-13B --env=STAGE ./scripts/kestrel_load.js
```

Add header warmup: 10k tokens/min for 10m before main run.

li_devex: Sample console tail we'll capture: 
```
[14:12:45] p50=85ms p95=310ms p99=720ms errors=0.8% throughput=320 req/s tokens/sec=45k
[14:45:01] p50=120ms p95=480ms p99=900ms errors=2.1% fallback_count=38
```

rebecca_cs: If we see >1% errors or p99>800ms we pause and switch to smaller model fallback. Also record unit cost delta so AE has numbers for renewal.

sanjay_pm: I'll prepare a short slide (1 page) summarizing SLOs, current baselines, and post-test action items for the renewal team.

li_devex: Enablement artifacts to include: quickstart runbook, failure/recovery steps, autoscale config snippet, contact matrix. Will post PR to confluence after test.

katie_cust: Customer request: enable a one-hour "warm traffic" window before go-live where we run lower volume but real traffic to prime KV cache. Can we add that to plan?

omar_sre: Yes. We'll schedule a prime window on Wed 09:00-10:00 UTC. Add to runbook as step 0.

rebecca_cs: Capturing feedback loop: li_devex please create a short form to capture customer qualitative feedback during pilot (3 fields: responsiveness, output quality, operational confidence). We'll include link in postmortem.

li_devex: Will create form and include screenshots + exportable CSV. Also enabling Redwood Optimize checks for quality drift across prompt sets.

deploybot: load-test starting at 2024-11-05T14:00:00Z (lt-kestrel-176999) — monitoring channel opened #kestrel-loads.

rebecca_cs: Thanks team — next check-in 1h before Tuesday run. Any blockers flag here now. :thumbsup:
